reviews.review_text:
Yarmies
Yarm10 contributions

A happy find!
Jul 2019 • Family
Happened upon this place on our first night in Ho Chi Minh city, and we are very pleased that we did! Staff were very welcoming, and the manager, Mr Khanh, was an exceptional host. A family of four, we each had something different from the western food menu and all thoroughly enjoyed the delicious food, and at excellent value too. It was so good that we returned for a second family meal on our last night. We ate different things and were impressed again by the quality of the food and care that went into its preparation - thank you to Mr Ly, the chef, for all of this! Great atmosphere, good value, and delicious food - if we are ever in Ho Chi Minh city again, we will be back!
